# Hosts scripts/fetch_asset.py may download from.
# Box-owned only. A redirect that leaves this list aborts the fetch.
# One host per line; subdomains of a listed host are allowed.
box.com
cdn.box.com
www-cdn.box.com
blog.box.com
# Box serves much of its site imagery from Contentful:
images.ctfassets.net
assets.ctfassets.net
downloads.ctfassets.net
